visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a young Asian man with black hair, wearing a white collared shirt, standing in a sunny outdoor park. He holds a white script and practices Chinese pronunciation with extremely exaggerated facial expressions, opening his mouth wide and tilting his head. (2) The scene shifts to the same man in a pink shirt, still in the park, looking up towards the sky while holding a script, appearing more focused but still reliant on the text. (3) He is then shown in a turquoise t-shirt, gesturing with his finger and displaying a look of confusion as he asks about the script length. (4) In a subsequent phase, he wears a mauve sweatshirt and points off-camera, interacting with an unseen manager. He looks mischievous as he asks for a 'cheat sheet.' (5) Wearing an orange sports jersey, he confidently flips through the script and suggests phrasing changes, showing increased comfort with the material. (6) A transition to 'Year 10' shows him in a blue basketball jersey and black cap, speaking fluently. The background shifts to a vibrant pink studio setting where he showcases a series of products including sea salt soap, a phone ring, a leather wallet, and enzyme powder, pointing at each with a bright, energetic smile. (7) Finally, he returns to the outdoor park setting, wipes his forehead in a gesture of completion, and walks away as the video ends.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: An Asian male with short black hair, appearing in multiple outfits: a white shirt, pink t-shirt, turquoise t-shirt, mauve sweatshirt, orange jersey, and a blue basketball jersey with a black cap.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Initial scenes take place in a grassy outdoor field with lighting equipment (umbrellas and softboxes) visible in the background. Later scenes use a bright pink studio background filled with various consumer products arranged neatly.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with upbeat acoustic guitar music. A male voice speaks rapidly in Japanese, then shifts to very slow, exaggeratedly toned Mandarin Chinese. Paper rustling is audible as he handles the script. (2) As the phases progress, the male voice maintains a high-arousal, comedic tone. Short 'Ding' and 'Pop' sound effects are introduced during transitions between the years. (3) In the middle section, the speech becomes more conversational and casual in Japanese, with a slightly lower pitch during humorous interactions. (4) The final segment features a high-energy, professional Mandarin narration. The BGM shifts to a faster electronic-pop beat with a clear kick drum. Rapid 'Whoosh' SFX accompany the fast-paced visual cuts between products. The audio ends with a satisfying camera shutter sound.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Year 1 -> Year 2 -> Year 3 -> Year 4 -> Year 5 -> Year 10 -> Climax/Product Showcase -> Wrap-up.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous storytelling approach to show the progression of the creator's Chinese language skills over ten years in Taiwan. It eventually pivots into a high-energy product showcase to promote 'Tokyo Mall,' an e-commerce platform by the Tokyo SME Support Center.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of multiple products, brand logo overlays, and a verbal call-to-action to visit the 'Tokyo Mall' store.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully blends comedic personal storytelling with a commercial endorsement, making the advertisement feel like a reward for following the creator's journey.
